# Mangrove Developer Docs

> Developer documentation for the Mangrove ecosystem -- REST APIs, Python and TypeScript SDKs, MCP servers, and x402-gated service templates for building agent-native trading and DEX-aggregation applications.

- [Introduction](https://docs.mangrovedeveloper.ai/introduction)
